notes.content:
First of all, the advance update of 2 days ago and this today are important events because they insert the basics and the new events of the DLC.

Let's go in order:

new events
new spells
new characters
new stories
new functions
new images

balance improvements

new zones for DLCs

Hope you like it!

I'll be announcing the third DLC soon, but maybe that tower in the picture ...

notes.title: information about updates
notes.content:
[b]Very important announcement![/b]

By overwhelming demand (pretty much everyone who has spoken to me) I say that, with this update, the Varietin dealer is selling the [b]repellent[/b]!
You can buy it or not, but to balance the introduction the appearance of monsters in the map is now more frequent (about 20%)
